scope: Profile only. No level or runtime edits. All ablations alter in-memory diagnostic copies. Isolated valid player placements cover sections; not a completed normal-control route.

method.nodeScan: 33 fresh runs: 120 cold and 480 measured 120 Hz ticks each. Player and Rbot poses sampled every fourth measured tick.
method.instrumentedNode: 60s entrance, 30s loaded rope, 15s chimney. Inclusive phase timers and 1ms CPU samples. Instrumented timing is attribution, not FPS evidence.
method.browser: 31 unprofiled measurements plus seven disturbed-rope probes. Hardware Chrome, readable production bundle, 1280x800, real RAF, capped 50ms accumulator, 120Hz physics, no adaptive quality, motion diagnostics disabled. 180 measured frames/30 warmup except isolated modes and 60s long run.
method.disturbed: Each rope receives one diagnostic horizontal impulse of 80 world units/sec at 70% material distance. Same map/objects retained. This is a stress probe, not evidence of a completed player route.
method.fixed: Fixed-two-tick comparison diagnoses catch-up amplification; not an equivalent physics-time trajectory or a proposed fix.
method.memory: Six repeated worlds in one page, full GC between worlds; retained JS heap only, not native GPU memory.
